opening.argument: The title identifies this as an episode of a series, and the description calls it a combination of drama and life stories. It describes ordinary people placed in scripted situations, with their emotions and interpersonal conflicts forming the program's focus. The title screen and broadcaster watermark reinforce that entertainment context. The links and prompts are presented as ordinary broadcaster, social-media, subscription, like, and comment requests, not as a deceptive offer or a requirement to participate financially. On the supplied account, those viewer requests do not change the character of the program: it is presented as a scripted life-story series, not a financial solicitation.

citations.quote: Kyiv day and night - Series 11 - Season 4
It combines the drama of the series and life stories.
Heroes are not actors, but ordinary guys who find themselves in the situations set by the script and show their natural, genuine emotions in them.
